name: steerlink
description: Steer and remote-control Claude Code from Grok Bot: delegate coding tasks, review every diff, and approve or deny each change. Also works with Codex and other ACP coding agents.

ACP_CONNECTOR_AUTH_MODE.title: Auth mode
ACP_CONNECTOR_AUTH_MODE.description: Use subscription with a Claude setup-token or stored Claude Code login. Use api_key only with an Anthropic Console key.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.title: Claude Code OAuth / setup-token
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: Paste the token from `claude setup-token` (Windows). Leave empty only if Claude Code is already logged in on this same Windows host.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.title: Anthropic API key (api_key mode only)
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Not needed in subscription mode. Your own key from platform.claude.com if you switch auth mode to api_key.

ACP_CONNECTOR_SESSION_VIEW.title: Session view
ACP_CONNECTOR_SESSION_VIEW.description: auto (default): show the live session view only where the app declares support. on: offer it anyway. off: never.
